subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular installer architecture now, and if so must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` entrypoint remain a single self-contained served script?
rationale: The request is maintainability work on a stable public setup surface, so automation cannot choose between a self-contained script, generated bundle, sourced helper tree, or smaller opportunistic refactors without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve a module layout only if the served installer remains safe for `curl | bash` and website sync plus installer smoke coverage are updated in the same plan.

options.title: Keep focused refactors
options.body: Leave this as backlog context and extract or delete installer sections only when tied to concrete bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that the Bash installer should remain monolithic to avoid helper-loading and packaging complexity on the public setup path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve a module layout only if the served installer remains safe for `curl | bash` and website sync plus installer smoke coverage are updated in the same plan.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer-specific repair and refactor commits make this the best available owner signal for deciding the split shape.
